text:
Maya: Quick proposal: unify our env var docs to a single canonical name and add graceful fallback for older names to reduce onboarding friction.
Ibrahim: yes please. I keep seeing REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY, RW_API_TOKEN in sample apps. causes confusion during rotation.
Jo: what's the canonical you want? my +1 is for REDWOOD_API_KEY (explicit) and REDWOOD_PROJECT for scoping.
Tess: agreed. also request we document precedence: explicit CLI flag > env var > config file. most users expect CLI flags to win.
Maya: plan: 1) Docs team makes canonical table (primary + legacy aliases + precedence) 2) SDKs/CLI add alias support + deprecation warning 3) sample-apps update to use canonical names and a small migration note.
Ibrahim: on SDK side let's implement alias resolution in a small central helper so parity is trivial across language SDKs. no duplicated env parsing logic.
Jo: can we add a quick compatibility mode: if legacy env var found, log a single warning per process: "DEPRECATED: please use REDWOOD_API_KEY" (non-fatal). That avoids noise but surfaces to devs.
Tess: rotation note: for short-lived keys we must ensure CLI/SDKs re-read env at invocation and not cache env-derived creds across process restarts. also document how to rotate via UI vs API.
Maya: sample-app onboarding failure we saw yesterday was because sample-apps were reading `~/.redwood/credentials` first, ignoring env entirely. patch incoming.
Ibrahim: for project vs org scoping: API keys can be org-scoped or project-scoped. whoami should print both when present. SDKs should expose `auth.scope` with values ["org","project"] or empty.
Jo: tiny nit: don't expose raw token in whoami logs. just ids and scopes.
Maya: agreed. also add an example snippet in docs for rotating keys during CI: 
```
# rotate secret
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=new_key_here
# restart short-lived runner
./deploy.sh
```
Tess: I'll add a checklist item for customers using short-lived keys in CI: ensure your runner picks env updates or use the config file method.
doc-bot: created issue RW-827: env-var naming canonicalization + SDK alias helper (assignees: Ibrahim, Tess)
Ibrahim: I'll sketch the helper this morning. idea: central envKey(nameVariants: string[]) -> string|undefined, with single deprecation log.
Jo: Can we also include a small test matrix for language SDKs (node/py/go/rust) so we catch parity regressions?
Maya: yes. add to the release checklist. docs PR will contain the canonical table and migration guide.
Tess: timeline? we should fix sample-app onboarding before EOD for the trial cohort.
Ibrahim: I can land SDK change + tests in ~3 hours. Jo can help with Go client parity.
Maya: great. please post the PR links here. Thanks all! :party_popper:
